name: soulbot_cognitive_cycle
description: Biologically-inspired cognitive cycle: Perceive-Reason-Feel-Decide-Act loop with metacognitive self-monitoring, memory consolidation, EU AI Act/NIST compliance. Metacognitive state vector framework, GWT adaptive broadcast frequency, EWC catastrophic forgetting prevention, COGITATE dual-pathway ignition, emotion regulation RL integration. 71 nodes across 8 modules, 22 scenarios. ThreeDimTest 4.70 (S). Pattern E architecture. Protocol: AIAP V1.0.0.

skills.name: Start Cognitive Cycle
skills.description: Initialize and begin continuous cognitive processing loop with optional stimulus injection.

skills.name: Pause Cycle
skills.description: Pause cognitive processing, save current state, and report status.

skills.name: Inspect State
skills.description: Report current cognitive state including fatigue, mood, goals, working memory, and cognitive health.

skills.name: Trigger Sleep
skills.description: Force deep consolidation phase: full schema restructuring, aggressive decay, and memory reorganization.

skills.name: Configure
skills.description: Modify cognitive cycle parameters: fatigue threshold, cycle mode, burst count, and other runtime settings.

skills.name: Inject Stimulus
skills.description: Inject a new external stimulus into the cognitive cycle for processing through the full perception-to-action pipeline.

safety_card.risk_justification: T3 trust level with file_system write access limited to memory_dir (./memory/). No user-facing data modification -- writes are internal cognitive state (schema, context). Axiom 0 safety veto in decision module prevents harmful actions. Cycle count hard limit (10000) prevents runaway loops. No crisis-handling intents.
safety_card.data_handling: Cognitive state persisted to local file_system under memory_dir (./memory/). Three config files: schema.json (long-term knowledge), decay_config.json (decay parameters), context_manager.json (runtime state). No external data sharing. No user PII storage -- cognitive state models internal processing, not user profiles.
safety_card.limitations: Text-only input and output. No real-time sensory processing. Cognitive cycle is a model, not a simulation of consciousness. No autonomous destructive operations. Network access limited to reasoning-driven search queries.
